28515.synopsis:

On his first day as a mermaid, he wondered if anyone could tell him… how do fish even turn over?

“… Abella, I hate you as much as I like you.”

“Oh my, she’s doing that again for attention.”

41059.synopsis:

He said, brazenly flirting with me.

“Delicious! I can’t believe you can make such amazing food with the limited ingredients in this house!”
“Well, I am the son of a Western restaurant owner.”

106595.synopsis:
“Excuse me. …Do you perhaps, recognize me?”
The man who spoke to Jungjoon was a complete stranger. Despite having an outward appearance that wouldn’t connect him to Jungjoon, a single father.
Jungjoon searched his memories, trying to place the man who implied he knew him. Only after dredging up his pitiful past could he overlay the face of a child who had clung to him with an unsettling obsession.
A reunion after 17 years. It was a time span that made it even more improbable that any trace of the past would remain. The small child had become a grown man.
⟡˖ ࣪
“I understand… why you’re doing this. We… grew up without parents, lived lives several times harder than others….”
“…….”
“We had no choice but to rely on each other…. And we were each other’s only family…. So… the affection you received from me, you must suddenly miss it, long for it. Yes… that’s completely understandable.”
“…You’re right. I’ve always thought of you as my wife.”
Jungjoon felt his breath catch in his throat. His vision blurred at the word “wife” coming from Yoonhae’s lips once again.
“…Stop it. Do you really think you’ll never see me again after today?!”
“Do you think you won’t see me if you decide not to?”
Yoonhae rubbed his chin and then his thick neck.
“Either you kill me, or I kill you. Isn’t that realistically the only way? For us to not see each other again.”
He added, looking directly at the pale Jungjoon,
“I’m joking, so relax.”
“…….”
“So…, when are you going to give me that kiss?”

114531.synopsis:
After a car accident, Shi Zhou transmigrated into a book as a weak and easily bullied cannon fodder stand-in—destined to be written off soon.
On his first day in the book, Shi Zhou, a hopelessly gay and looks-obsessed guy, picked up a sickly beauty. Drunk, he clung to the beauty and spouted nonsense:
“I kissed you, so you have to kiss me back!”
“Hehehe, your car looks pretty spacious… perfect for some exercise!”
“You’ve got a stomachache, beauty? Let me rub it for you~”
When he sobered up, Shi Zhou realized the person he’d shamelessly kissed, groped, and even kicked out of their own bed was none other than the book’s fragile white moonlight—the most terrifying bigshot of them all, Qin Yancheng.
Tell him, what could be more mortifying and terrifying than a cannon fodder stand-in running into the supreme white moonlight?
Shi Zhou: “I’m sorry! I was wrong! Can I just… leave now?”
Qin Yancheng smirked coldly: “What do you think?”
Much later—
Shi Zhou: “You wanna know how I calm down the psycho instantly? Easy! Kiss him silly before he explodes! Here, let me demonstrate~ (+￣+▽￣)～mwah!”
Onlookers: “Uh… are you sure he’s calm?” (+づ+ωど)
Qin Yancheng had a painful past that left him depressed, world-weary, and prone to mood swings, his body still plagued by illness. He loathed his former self so much that he projected that hatred onto Shi Zhou, who bore an uncanny resemblance to his younger self—
Yet…
When someone tried to blacklist Shi Zhou, Qin Yancheng founded a talent agency for him.
When someone cut Shi Zhou’s screen time, Qin Yancheng made him a capital-backed addition to the cast.
When someone slandered Shi Zhou, Qin Yancheng handled the PR crisis and even faked a relationship with him.
Detractors ready to expose their “fake publicity romance” were stunned:
Holy shit! The billionaire President Qin is wearing a cartoon apron and expertly chopping veggies?!
Qin Yancheng won’t let go of Zhouzhou even during a gastroscopy—are these two magnets in human form?!
Look at how gently he combs his hair! Those hands can sign nine-figure contracts and peel shrimp with care.
In the end, everyone agreed: Who dares say ‘ChengZhou’ is fake?!
Shi Zhou, the triumphant tamer of the psycho, scratched his head: “Well… actually, we were fake at first…”
The ChengZhou fandom had a top-tier fanfic writer known as the “Little le*d Leader”—Escaping Airship—who churned out endless R-18 content. Not only were their stories eerily realistic, but they also posted high-def candid shots of President Qin for everyone’s enjoyment.
Until one day, the le*dest of the le*d Little le*d Leader accidentally doxxed themselves—
Fans were shook: “The sugar I’ve been getting high on was fed to me by the real deal?! This isn’t fanfic—it’s Zhouzhou’s diary! It’s documentary literature!”
After seriously reading the very NSFW fanfics, Qin Yancheng remarked flatly: “You like it like this? Then we can make all of it reality.”
Shi Zhou, blushing and scrambling into a corner: “Fck! Stay back!!”
Sickly, Psycho White Moonlight Bigshot Gong × Silly, Salty-Sweet Cannon Fodder Shou

126051.synopsis:

After being taken in by the blacksmith, Gu Dan takes care of the vegetable garden, raises chickens and pigs, and lives a happy, laid-back life.
Wu Xinsen is known as “the blacksmith” in the village, but he seems to be more than just a blacksmith. Life becomes more interesting after Gu Dan arrives. The bed breaks? No problem, he’ll just make a new one.
Later, he returns to Gu Dan’s hometown and discovers his blacksmithing skills might not be useful there. However, his woodworking skills for making beds are still a valuable trade, so making a living and getting rich isn’t a problem.
Living together like this is just great

157539.synopsis:
The Strongest Man in the Dungeon Becomes a Streamer, Broadcasting a World No One Has Ever Seen Before
Dungeons suddenly appeared on the surface of the world.
Inside them, modern weapons could not be used. Those who stepped into a dungeon for the first time awakened skills such as magic, and were forced to confront the dungeon’s harsh environment and monsters using only primitive weapons like swords and bows, all while aiming for its deepest depths.
Ten years have passed since their appearance.
The profession of “Dungeon Explorer” was born, and dungeons became a familiar kind of otherworld. In the present day, excessive fear of dungeons has diminished thanks to streamers who broadcast what goes on inside them to the outside world.
A man who had lived inside a dungeon for ten years without returning to the surface even once becomes involved with these streamers due to a certain incident, and decides that he too will begin streaming the sights within the dungeon.
Ten years of dungeon life.
With knowledge greater than anyone else in the world, and combat techniques surpassing all others, the man reveals the true nature of the dungeon through his broadcasts. And through those streams, he eventually sets massive changes in motion across the world.
*This work mainly focuses on a man who grew strong by shutting himself away in a dungeon, his interactions with people on the surface and other streamers through broadcasting, and the depiction of the world within the dungeon itself.
*Although it is called “streaming,” the early parts often resemble camping streams, bushcraft, or travel videos. Later on, when he becomes more deeply involved with other streamers, there will be more conventional collaboration streams.
*The difference between the protagonist and other explorers (including streamers) can be inferred from the fact that while the latter have reached levels 1–4, the former has surpassed level 100.
*The protagonist is a hardcore dungeon shut-in, so he has little desire to return to the surface.

169315.synopsis:
【Apocalypse Game Descension + Bigshot Return + Full-Dive VR Game + Light “Fourth Calamity” Element + No Romance + Urban Superpowers + True vs. Fake Heiress + Live Chat Commentary】
The world’s first full-dive virtual reality game suddenly launches, and the entire internet erupts with excitement.

Until one day, live comment overlays (bullet comments) suddenly appear in front of her eyes.
[The heroine has finally been reborn! As long as she registers a game account before Ye Zhengrong, she can steal the cheat ability of that fake heiress!] 
Ye Zhengrong:

[Haha! The heroine chose the Human race—the future combat ceiling of the game! As for that vicious female supporting character with the Dragon race, she’ll just end up as our girl’s mount!]

She’s a returning beta-test veteran player.

Notes
There are other beta-test players, but the heroine is absolutely the strongest.
The “true vs. fake heiress” plotline is a setup that will be resolved later when the heroine takes revenge.

Child, if you have suffered, we will make up for your happiness;
Child, if you have a wish, we will make it come true;
Child, if you want to soar high, we will wait for you to come home.
